GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3 Wide at 1000m, circled field to join Lead at the 600m, led Two Wide jointly turning, Headed Straightening Up , came back to challenge inside the furlong but then faded to the line # Had a tough run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover from the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then hampered and Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, dropped right out in Straight # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and then hampered. Lost a near fore plate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped very awkwardly making heavy barrier contact, missed start 2 Lengths and Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn and Lost Ground in Straight # Bungled the start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly, made heavy contact with gates and was slow into stride. Near the 175m was steadied when in restricted room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Hampered (-1 lngth) at the start then taken straight across and Settled Down equal last 10 Lengths 3 Wide , worked up out Wide middle stages, trailed 3.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Held Ground to the line. (Barrier Extension OFF FIRST TIME) # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered at the start and contacted hindquarters.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Restrained thus Settled Down th Outside 5 Lengths 3 Wide x 600m Drifted Back rear Turning for home then plugged on one pace to the line - # Just Held Ground

Slow out & Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, hooked 3 Wide at 800m and Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths 2-3 Wide turning, Held Up home turn before improving a length in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Held up for clear running approaching the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced well back Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed well back Two Wide midrace & chasing 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed along Four Wide @ 450m & pressured Six Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Worked home OK in straight. # Fair from rear.

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 700m, Made Some Ground to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF FIRST TIME) # Wide last 700m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. Raced three-wide without cover from the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , oressed forward and settled Two Wide Outside the leader at 1300m, Moved Up to within a head turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN) [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey reported that when caught Wide she allowed it to stride forward, settling further forward than anticipated. She added it failed to respond to riding on straightening, was inclined to lay in and proved disappointing over the concluding stages. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # worked a birt early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on a number of occasions leaving the 100m. Rdr reported after being caught wide, allowed mount to stride and settled further forward than initially anticipated-added that on straightening, mount failed to respond to riding, was inclined to lay in and proved disappointing over the concluding stages. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay then hampered & Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 12 Lengths turning, weakened from 400m dropping right out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # weakened x-badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered shortly after the start. A post-race vet exam of gelding which weakened from the 400m revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, Moved Up to Turn then Hooked Out to 5 Lengths 3 Wide , couldn't come on in straight. (Barrier Extension FIRST TIME) # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Leaving the 1000m, improved onto heels and steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, held its ground in Straight # battled on fairly
